title: AiOfferPool
description: ai.offer-pool@1 (the pooled machines design, 2026-11-06): the `pool` part of a community AI offer (ai.offer@1) served by several of one owner's machines together (bot.machine-pool@1). Network adds it from its own approved pool record, never from what a machine reports: the offer is the head's, `head` equals the offer's `machine_id`, and while a machine is in a pool it advertises no offer of its own. It names machines only; no address, key or certificate reaches AI. AI routes the request to the head, runs the same verification as for one machine (canaries, the model fingerprint, spot re-runs) on the pool's answers, keys that verification on this exact membership (another member or head is a new, unverified pool), keeps a pool that is new or failed to the free tier only, and labels its answers "Community pool (N machines)".

machines.description: The pool's machines, head included (Bot device ids), two to eight.

head.description: The machine that answers: one of `machines`, and the offer's own `machine_id`.
